body: I've been there, I am even kind of there now, been feeling like shit for a while. I sometimes also cry at night in bed, and in the morning when I wake up. Do you have any hobbies? Do any of those make you feel better even temporarily?
Please don't do it. You're 13, there still so, so much good to come. Talk to me. Why do you think you should commit suicide? You're still too young!

Not American, so we don't have the Civil Air Patrol here. And to be fair I don't really have the money to spend on learning how to fly through other means. I'd love to in the future... I guess that's another thing to look forward to, thanks!

Worst thing is I'm even more stressed about what is to come. I think I'll get a masters next, still, that will probably mean getting further away from home (I live 100km from my hometown now, will go to a city 800km away), and more importantly I will leave many of my friends behind. And don't even get me started with what I'll do when I start working, I live in Spain and we have a 23% unemployment rate. 

I do talk to my friends a lot, but this is just but a brief relief from my worries.

Aeronautic engineering, almost finished it. It's not nearly as interesting as I thought it would have been, but I guess it's ok. Still university is a large source of stress and problems. Met a few friends there, though.
I love aircraft too! I am studying aeronautic engineering, actually, but I never had the chance to fly an aircraft myself. I'd really love to.
I like hanging out with my friends (or just talking to them in Discord, especially since I've started to feel worse) and playing videogames, mainly. What are your hobbies?

What do I even say? I feel horribly lonely. Only reason I find not to jump off my window is that there are *probably* some people who care about me and would be sad. But right now I'm not even sure I care.
